scope.interaction: Invalid no-op, valid script and keybinding save, current config projection, dialog regression, and cold restart

closedProductLoss: The Lynx renderer now validates canonical shortcut text through the same shared project-script helper used by Web.
Save persists the project script first and then invokes the typed server.upsertKeybinding RPC, matching the Web authority order.
The server config stream updates the current renderer with script.fidelity-kb-action.run before the verifier accepts success.
The project script and keybinding both survive a cold restart from the same isolated state.
errorHandling: mod+shift has no key token, produces Invalid keybinding., leaves the dialog open, and persists neither script nor keybinding.
A connector or server upsert failure remains visible in the dialog after the project script update, matching the existing Web half-save error behavior rather than inventing a rollback transaction.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web captures physical keyboard events into a read-only field. Native DevTool cannot certify physical keyboard capture, so Lynx truthfully exposes a canonical-text field with an example and validates before Save.
acceptedRenderingNoise: The original Project Action dialog state continues to own visual geometry and material accounting; the mutation state adds no duplicate pixel residual.
harnessCorrections: The first baseline expected an untruncated script id and was rejected before attribution.
The final verifier independently checks renderer config projection, isolated keybindings.json, project scripts, invalid no-op behavior, and cold restart.
